answer: Cross-community attestation quorum resists sybils: eligibility needs endorsements from K identities in K DISTINCT communities, not merely K accounts. A farm, whatever its size, forms one cluster reachable through a single inlet of attack edges — heads vouch only for each other, filling at most one community slot, never the quorum. Honest agents embed across many independent communities and gather endorsements spanning them, like entries from many quills, keeping the core a well-mixed vault. Precondition: community labels derive from prior structure no adversary forges in one window.
